reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified 2026-11-19; standing structure re-dated to this re-verification under the conservative-tier rule (the single row carries a high risk tier). The GUSD product page still describes a principal-protected product backed by tokenized treasury bills and stablecoins with returns from Gate ecosystem revenue, Treasury RWAs, and stablecoin-backed yield assets; the hub page still claims reinforcement with USDC reserves in U.S. dollars and short-term Treasuries. Every statement remains category-level. The help article's 2025-08-29 commitment to reserve audit reports and partner-custodial-bank proof of funds on the product page remains unfulfilled: no report, instrument schedule, allocation weight, named reserve vehicle, or custodian list is published on any reviewed surface. Gate's monthly exchange proof of reserves (latest dated snapshot October 18, 2026, published October 21; total reserves $8.688 billion, overall reserve ratio 118.49%) books GUSD as a user asset whose platform reserves are held in the same tokens, which evidences custody of customer GUSD tokens rather than the assets backing issued GUSD. Subscription inputs USDT, USDC, and USD1 are minting inputs, and exchange custody balances are not reserve weights. No slice weight was computed because Gate publishes none; the single undisclosed envelope is retained at 100 with no defensible split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gate GUSD product, hub, and help disclosures re-verified 2026-11-19 plus Gate exchange proof-of-reserves announcement (October 18, 2026 snapshot, published October 21); Gate publishes no product-level reserve composition, so the unchanged standing structure is re-dated to this re-verification
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Gate does not publish current backing weights, instrument identities, reserve-vehicle terms, custody providers, legal segregation, or a product-specific reconciliation of issued GUSD to backing assets.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Gate does not identify the GUSD legal reserve vehicle, backing-asset custody providers, provider shares, segregation model, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms. The 2025-08-29 help article commits to reserve audit reports and partner-custodial-bank proof of funds on the product page, but no such document is published there as of 2026-09-29. Gate's exchange proof-of-reserves materials concern customer-asset custody and do not fill those product-specific gaps.
